podcast.body: This album featured the single "Pork and Beans", known for its video which incorporated various internet personalities and memes of the day. The band's leader, Rivers Cuomo, with his bookish, neurotic, and socially awkward personality, reinforces Weezer's image as a quintessential nerd rock band. "If you remember the video, if you're doing all the internet personalities and memes of the day, it's really tough to imagine anything more nerdy."

podcast.body: This was the band's sixth album, following the Blue Album (1994) and Green Album (2001). It was self-titled and simply known as the Red Album due to its color. The album marked the beginning of a very prolific period for the band and included an interview with the host incorporated into the liner notes. "The red album marked the beginning of a very prolific period for the band."
